title: M0 — Prove the ACP integration paths
description: Establish what the installed providers actually support before building orchestration. Capture versions, authentication, protocol capabilities and unsupported behavior. No production tasks or broad worker privileges are needed for this experiment.
why: A reliable assistant cannot depend on assumed provider features.

acceptance.text: Both requested targets have an evidence-backed compatibility result

outcome.summary: Both M0 ACP provider investigations are complete and linked child tickets MAST-23 and MAST-24 are done.
outcome.verifiedBy: Cursor ACP and Codex ACP completed isolated protocol checks; versions, auth status, capabilities, permission/cancellation behavior and extension caveats are recorded in child ticket comments.
